usage: cli.py strategy [-h] [--snapshot SNAPSHOT] [--store STORE] [--latest]
                       [--cfg CFG] [--out OUT] [--no-clobber]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --snapshot SNAPSHOT  Path to snapshot JSON (or '-' for stdin)
  --store STORE        Store directory (use with --latest)
  --latest             Use latest snapshot from store
  --cfg CFG            Path to strategy config
  --out OUT            Output strategy JSON path (or '-' for stdout)
  --no-clobber         Fail if output file already exists.
